steps.text: Two reports that look alike are not necessarily the same bug. Check whether they share a code path before merging them.
Looking at **PD-118 — Inspection PDFs hang at 99% on large scans**. Two brokerages, both on scans over 1GB.

steps.result:
lib/documents/upload_client.dart:52:      onUploadProgress: (sent, total) => _progress.add(sent / total),
lib/documents/upload_client.dart:78:    final contentLength = await file.length();

steps.text:
It isn't hanging. `onUploadProgress` reaches 100% when the last byte leaves the client, but `_finalize()` then waits on a server-side notarization check that takes ~30s on a 1GB scan. The bar sits at 99% (rounding) with no indication anything is still happening, so the agent assumes it hung and cancels.

So it's a **reporting** bug, not a transfer bug — which also explains why it only shows up on large scans and why the packets that "failed" are actually notarized and present in the closing file.

I've moved PD-118 to **in progress**, retitled it to name the real cause, and linked PD-121 as a duplicate. The fix is a distinct notarization-pending state rather than a progress percentage — Priya already has it open in **#401**, so I pointed the ticket there instead of starting a second PR.
